body:
STATUS — the search/selection leg now completes end to end; first standup verified running.

**1. Erratum on my audit (7095271509).** That comment says the app rewrites its own title. Measured false: the window title stayed `Freebuff: The free coding agent` throughout a Kalshi session, and through every run below. What is actually measured is handle recycling (pid 6652: 51709886 → 4261648 → 3475728 → 5179184 → 3475728) and nothing else. Withdrawing that sentence; the rest of the audit stands.

**2. Class cure, 11 commits on `laptop-vision-20261122` (head `b4f2e40`).**
- `5f20f86` PID-owned window discovery + settle, deterministic dialog reset, session-list walk, settled two-census rosters, tolerant row matching, UIA-free identity, navigation-aware prepare.
- `50f9d99` repeated-step scroll to top; navigation only where input cannot be lost; `settle_view`.
- `9412e9e` dialog state read from its own close glyph, one toggle retry.
- `26c98f6` row match survives the OCR slips actually present (`Kalshi Paper Bumdown V`, `…Burndov`, `…Bumd`, `Carrier Census Verifica` all resolve to their intended rows; no false match between `Kalshi Paper Rotation archive` and `Kalshi Paper Burndown`).
- `f493cd2` draft readback compared tolerantly, not byte-equal.
- `3b7e5fe` the query phase creates the dialog instead of assuming the search phase made one.
- `11e52c5` identity accepts the pinned route from the exposed set and records every route seen.
- `e8e0918` send uses the identity proof, not the route-only gate.
- `9adaeea` bounded search for the selected row wherever the list has scrolled.
- `e6c392d` composer settle measured against caret-sized drift.
- `b4f2e40` **roster settle compared on row geometry, not OCR text** — see 3.

**3. The defect behind "a census row moved during navigation" was my own comparator.** Filed runs show one unchanged row alternating `Kalshi Paper Bumd` ↔ `Kalshi Paper Burndc V` and `New chat` ↔ `Ra New chat` across censuses, at identical y, until the attempt budget ran out. Text equality can never settle on this app; row positions can. After the change, the same page settles in 2 censuses and every phase that used to burn 5 tried censuses passes first time.

**4. Standup — `7d4a9b14` (Kalshi Paper Burndown) is RUNNING.** Driver: settled roster (20 rows, 2 censuses) → selected row `Kalshi Paper Burndc` matched → identity `settled sidebar selection` → turn detected in flight → no restart input sent (one-send fence respected). The filed frame shows the lane's own turn mid-stream with the Stop control live and its composer empty. Evidence: [trace](https://github.com/Treystu/slow-lane-ledger/blob/da394b6/dispatch/laptop-driver/evidence/t8/7093818060-7d4a9b14-cure-chain/driver.jsonl) · [running turn](https://github.com/Treystu/slow-lane-ledger/blob/da394b6/dispatch/laptop-driver/evidence/t8/7093818060-7d4a9b14-cure-chain/running-turn.png) · [staged draft from the earlier phase](https://github.com/Treystu/slow-lane-ledger/blob/da394b6/dispatch/laptop-driver/evidence/t8/7093818060-7d4a9b14-cure-chain/staged-draft.png).

**5. In flight now** (background queue, sequential): `9ecc3453` Lane 2, `918dad1a` Harness Audit, `0319b9f6` SCM Audit. Then `0d7e2f37`: the census reads five BigEnergyCo sessions and no row carrying the bare label, so I will not guess — identification moves to the session route (open candidate, read the app's own route, match the UUID). `2ae32937` SCMessenger last, on a unique enumeration match, with its project census after.

Blocking step, stated plainly: nothing is blocked right now — the queue is running and each lane's result will be filed as it lands.
